name: Chikusei (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chikusei city emblem in green and blue: a disc of green with a white mountain above blue wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Chikusei, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Chikusei city emblem — a disc of green with a white mountain above blue wavy lines
